alice_pm: Quick sync — defining GA entry for the "lift-and-shift" migration feature. Need signoffs on SLA, runbook, docs, support, pricing. What's must-have vs nice-to-have? :eyes:
ben_sre: SRE: Must have: concrete SLOs (availability + latency), alerting, error budget, dashboards. We also need a baseline perf report. Example alert: `rate(err_count[5m]) / rate(req_count[5m]) > 0.01`
dave_eng: Eng: Perf matrix incoming. For small models p95 ~ 120ms on dedi; p99 for large models depends. We'll surface perf variance by seq len. Can we treat private as 'best effort' with clear caveat?
carla_docs: Docs: Need quickstart, upgrade notes, API compat matrix, runbook (triage steps + sample curl). I'll draft quickstart if someone provides sample curl + expected responses.
fiona_support: Support: Add canned replies for timeout/errors, and a triage checklist. We need the runbook before GA. Also confirm oncall rota for first 2 weeks post-GA.
erin_sales: Sales: Pricing tiers must include dedicated reserved vs burst. Propose migration credits for existing customers for first 90 days. Need cost per 1M tokens from Optimize team to build modeled tiers.
alice_pm: Proposed must-haves: 1) SLA doc with SLOs+alerts 2) Triage runbook 3) Public quickstart + compat matrix 4) Pricing sheet + migration option 5) Support rota. Nice-to-have: customer migration guide + benchmark scripts.
ben_sre: I'll own SLA doc + dashboard templates, will open PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/ga-slas - draft by EOD Tue. I'll also add the alert rule and sample grafana panels.
dave_eng: I'll run load tests and put perf table in the PR. Need approval on model bundle for perf runs (@alice_pm).
carla_docs: I'll take quickstart + runbook. Assign upgrade notes to @dave_eng. ETA: Wed.
erin_sales: I'll draft pricing and migration credit proposal and sync with finance. ETA Thu COB.
fiona_support: I'll draft support triage + canned replies. Need a short playbook for escalations. @ben_sre can you give the incident thresholds?
alice_pm: Decision: GA gate = SLA draft + runbook + public quickstart + pricing sheet + support rota. If all done by next Wed (2100648000) we go to shiproom. Owners: SLA=ben, Runbook=carla, Perf=dave, Pricing=erin, Support=fiona. Any blockers?
ben_sre: No blockers from SRE, except validation on private deploy perf. Will flag if needed.
deploy_bot: deploy_bot: Reminder: GA checklist template created at /docs/ga-readiness-template.md and assigned to channel #product.
alice_pm: :thumbsup: thanks team — will follow up with calendar invite for Wednesday review.
